claim_boundary: Static source-integrity input only. This manifest binds the editable CadQuery source and parameter contract by SHA-256. It does not assert CadQuery execution, FCStd/STEP creation, manufacturing release, supplier interface release, material selection, hole/thread/seal definition, tolerance, pressure rating, mass-property proof, or vehicle readiness.

verification.update_rule: Update this manifest in the same reviewed change whenever its editable source or contract input changes. A matching hash does not authorize CadQuery execution or native export.
